mechanism_narrative: The steady rise in TRANSIT from +0.3 to +4.1 over the three weeks before the decision point signals recovering commuting and leisure travel, which raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT increased from 0.3 at t-3w to 4.1 at t-1w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains at or above +3 for the next two weeks but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The drop in WORKPLACES from -6.3 to -9.4 in the latest week signals reduced office commuting, cutting weekday foot traffic that supports retail and recreation, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -6.3 at t-3w to -9.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays at or below -9 for the next two weeks but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS below -20 in early summer indicates weather or outdoor constraints that suppress park-linked trips and nearby retail, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was -20.0 at t-0w and -21.9 at t-3w
failure_condition: If PARKS is at or below -20 for two consecutive weeks but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +5 for two consecutive weeks, essential-errand routines strengthen and spill over into adjacent retail and recreation, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM is at or above +5 for two consecutive weeks but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of WORKPLACES at or below -8 with RESIDENTIAL at or above +5 indicates remote-work nesting that redirects spending to neighborhood retail, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -9.4 and RESIDENTIAL is 5.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES is at or below -8 and RESIDENTIAL is at or above +5 for two consecutive weeks but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is less than or equal to over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT at or above +3 combined with PARKS at or below -18 means people are resuming city trips while outdoor park options remain weak, shifting recreation demand into retail venues and raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is 3.7 and PARKS is -20.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT is at or above +3 and PARKS is at or below -18 for two consecutive weeks but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, GROCERY_PHARM above +4 signals retained essential activity while TRANSIT above +3 signals restored movement, together rotating spending toward RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is 4.1 and TRANSIT is 3.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: In a reopening regime with GROCERY_PHARM at or above +4 and TRANSIT at or above +3, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -9.4 and RESIDENTIAL is 5.3 at t-0w
